entities.name: Fahd bin Salman bin Abdulaziz Al Saud

entities.summary: Fahd bin Salman Al Saud was a Saudi royal, businessman, and thoroughbred racer. He was a son of King Salman and one of the grandsons of Saudi's founder King Abdulaziz.
